title: Training of AI models

statement.en: Data shared within the data space shall not be reproduced or extracted for the training of AI models, except where such use has been expressly authorised by the data provider.

control: The data provider states in the offer whether AI training is authorised; the constitutive agreement prohibits it otherwise

expressions.note: Contractual prohibition in the constitutive agreement.
AI-use flag in the offer (dssc:M3.catalogue.01) and ODRL prohibition on AI training in the usage policy (dssc:M3.policy.01).
